title: Binary search
code:
local function search(items, target)
    local low, high = 1, #items
    ⟦while low <= high do
        local mid = math.floor((low + high) / 2)
        if items[mid] == target then return mid end
        if items[mid] < target then low = mid + 1 else high = mid - 1 end
    end⟧
    return nil
end
